name: Ravidel
description: A battlemage and planeswalker, resurrected by Kristina, who seeks vengeance on the Sages with the Golgothian Sylex and serves the master Taysir.

timeline.summary: Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina and Jared during her duel with Ravidel so he will not take them.
timeline.quote: Liana gave them to Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion during her duel with Ravidel at Minorad so that he would not take them.

citation.text: "Mox", section "Moxen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, Ravidel uses Mox Jet, Mox Ruby and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.
timeline.quote: Ravidel used the Mox Jet , Mox Ruby , and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon

citation.text: "Mox", section "Moxen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel ravages Arathoxia with the Chaos Orb in 4195 AR, causing its fall.
timeline.quote: In 4195 AR, Ravidel ravaged the city using the Chaos Orb

citation.text: "Arathoxia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chromium pledges to Faralyn and befriends Ravidel; Arcades Sabboth is killed by Kristina.
timeline.quote: Chromium once again pledged allegiance to a planeswalker

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Serving Faralyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel is killed but revived by Kristina and Taysir, and plots vengeance.
timeline.quote: Ravidel plotted vengeance for ages

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel fashions Chromium's corpse into the Planar Barge.
timeline.quote: Ravidel took Chromium's corpse and fashioned it into what he called a Planar Barge

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Planar Barge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel creates the Mox Beacon to lure Corondor's old enemies in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: created the Mox Beacon to lure them to Corondor

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section ""Modern times"". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adam sacrifices his wife to Ravidel, refuses to sacrifice Jared and battles Ravidel; Jared is hit by a syphon soul and changed.
timeline.quote: Jared was hit by a syphon soul in this battle

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel conquers Arathoxia; Jared steals the Lotus, leads refugees against Ravidel at Castle Melmereth and summons a Shivan Dragon.
timeline.quote: Ravidel tracked Jared down and conquered Arathoxia

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared learns Ravidel is alive; Liana dies; Ravidel activates the Mox Beacon starting the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: activated the Mox Beacon that would start the Planeswalker War

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Confrontation and ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared battles Ravidel at the Dueling Chasm, ascends as a planeswalker and saves Kristina, though Altair dies.
timeline.quote: Jared ascended and became a planeswalker

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Confrontation and ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eusomoné is summoned by his son Jared to fight Ravidel's giant spiders and gives him Foecleaver.
timeline.quote: He gave Jared Foecleaver

citation.text: "Mina", section "Eusomoné". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Betrayers escape the Shard after Chromium and Ravidel die at the Summit of the Null Moon.
timeline.quote: No planeswalker died, but the deaths of Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel proved enough to let the betrayers escape.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel obtains a Sylex after a duel and threatens the Sages of Minorad, extracting a promise not to interfere.
timeline.quote: Ravidel appeared at Minorad and threatened to use the Sylex

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Destruction?". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared Carthalion uses the long-daggers to make that Sylex vulnerable to a shatter spell, which destroys it.
timeline.quote: Jared used the daggers to make it vulnerable to a shatter spell, which finally destroyed the artifact.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Destruction?". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Faralyn uses Rhuell's death energy to open the rift; Lim-Dul escapes and Leshrac kills Ravidel with Fire Covenant.
timeline.quote: Leshrac casts Fire Covenant , bringing fiery harm to all present and killing Ravidel.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kristina and Taysir resurrect Ravidel, who declares Kristina his enemy.
timeline.quote: He doesn't agree with Kristina changing his fate and declares her his enemy forever.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupts among the planeswalkers; Ravidel and Rhuell die and Taysir and Kristina revive Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Taysir and his lover combined their magic to bring Ravidel back to life

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel and the Scarlet Vizier launch a sudden assault on Minorad out of resentment toward Kristina.
timeline.quote: launched a sudden and brutal assault on Minorad

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel threatens annihilation with the Golgothian Sylex and forces the sages into an oath of non-interference.
timeline.quote: he forced the sages to submit to his will

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Altair is bound to the land, stripped of planeswalker abilities and memory.
timeline.quote: stripped of his planeswalker abilities

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kristina is confined to her enchanted forest.
timeline.quote: Kristina of the Woods was confined to her enchanted forest

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Spirit reveals that Ravidel is alive and hunting Liana and her Moxes.
timeline.quote: It reveals to Jared that Ravidel is alive and is hunting Liana of Minorad and her three Moxes

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 2: Forces of Nature". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel duels Liana for her Moxes and reveals his master is Taysir.
timeline.quote: He reveals to her that his Master is Taysir

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lays waste to Minorad.
timeline.quote: Ravidel has broken his promise, and laid waste to Minorad

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Élan shoots Ravidel and Ravidel kills her with a blast of fire.
timeline.quote: Ravidel reciprocates, killing her with a blast of fire.

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana gives Jared her Moxes and sends herself and Ravidel into the Abyss.
timeline.quote: She then casts a spell to send herself and Ravidel into the Abyss

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel resurrects the Scarlet Vizier as a zombie and destroys him.
timeline.quote: the battlemage Ravidel briefly resurrects the Scarlet Vizier as a zombie to torment him

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 5: Dark Eminence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared destroys the Golgothian Sylex with the Rust Daggers.
timeline.quote: Jared has the Rust Daggers and uses them to cast a Shatter spell on the Sylex, destroying it.

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 5: Dark Eminence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel steals the three Moxes and sends a beacon for other planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Ravidel steals the three Moxes from Kristina

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 5: Dark Eminence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared destroys the ground under Ravidel, who falls into the chasm.
timeline.quote: Jared destroys the ground under Ravidel who falls into the chasm

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 5: Dark Eminence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adam Carthalion's army is destroyed at the Battle of Aster Fall and Ravidel takes up residence in Castle Melmereth.
timeline.quote: After Adam died in the Battle of Aster Fall , Ravidel took up residence in the castle.

citation.text: "Stonehaven", section "Stonehaven locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adam Carthalion is defeated by Ravidel at Ephren, entrusts his spelltrove and infant Jared to Ezer, and obliterates Ravidel's barge and himself with Inferno.
timeline.quote: He then casts an Inferno spell, obliterating Ravidel's barge and himself along with it.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Seven years later Jared disintegrates a berserker sent by Ravidel with a scroll from his father's spelltrove, and Ezer names him the Shadow Mage.
timeline.quote: Ezer joyfully notes that Jared now has access to red magic, and names the child The Shadow Mage .

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared steals the Black Lotus, learns of his mother, and with Liana escapes the baths; Ravidel beats Jared back until Liana reveals three Moxes and Ravidel leaves.
timeline.quote: Liana reveals she has three Moxes , giving her the upper hand in a duel.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 2: Desolate Angel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel attacks Arathoxia with juggernauts and a Chaos Orb that annihilates Bikov and the port; the Scarlet Vizier dies telling Jared his mother was murdered and frees Liana; Ravidel kills Verdenth.
timeline.quote: With his last breath, the vizier releases Liana from his indentured servitude.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 3: War Child". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared swears vengeance on Ravidel for the murder of his parents.
timeline.quote: Jared swears vengeance against Ravidel for the murder of his parents.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 3: War Child". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Castle Melmereth Ravidel reveals Adam was a liar and killer who murdered Gwendolyn for power and planned to sacrifice Jared before changing his mind.
timeline.quote: He murdered his wife Gwendolyn Carthalion in the hopes that it would grant him power to become a Planeswalker .

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Narok kills Nikko and Jared annihilates Narok, then crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle; Ezer dies, and the castle explodes from Liana's sorcery.
timeline.quote: Jared crushes the Black Lotus and summons a Shivan Dragon

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kristina turns Taysir away and he turns to vengeance against Leshrac and Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: she has no choice but to turn him away

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel visits Urborg to recruit Lord Windgrace, who rejects him; Ravidel takes a shard of Urborgan obsidian.
timeline.quote: Before departing, Ravidel took a shard of Urborgan obsidian with him

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck destroys Eskil's hut, but Eskil takes him to New Argive, and Embereck learns of Ravidel's deceit and agrees to stand against him.
timeline.quote: Embereck agreed to stand against him.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel manipulates Sandruu with misleading images of Kristina and Jared, enraging him.
timeline.quote: Showing Sandruu misleading images of Kristina with Jared, he stoked the minotaur’s fury.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel conquers Shikar and assembles an artifact that suppresses the spellcasting of planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: The finished artifact was activated, suppressing the spellcasting of the Planeswalkers drawn into the war.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck dies fighting Ravidel and Leshrac flees; Taysir then confronts Ravidel, who nearly defeats his mentor until Teferi intervenes.
timeline.quote: Embereck perished in the battle, and Leshrac fled.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel's summoning backfires, a sinkhole forms under Hamath, and he plunges into the abyss while Dakkon routs his forces; he is assumed dead.
timeline.quote: Ravidel was not heard from again and was assumed to be dead.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel conquers Shikar and uses five obsidian stones to hinder other planeswalkers' casting.
timeline.quote: Next, Daria sees Ravidel conquering the city of Shikar in eastern Corondor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel tries to recruit Jared for his crusade against planeswalkers and leaves Justina unharmed.
timeline.quote: Ravidel tries to recruit Jared for his crusade to eliminate all the other planeswalkers

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel's first attack on Hamath is repulsed with Freyalise and Dakkon's help.
timeline.quote: Thus, Ravidel's initial attack on Hamath is repulsed.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel kills the Elder Druid of Corondor.
timeline.quote: Ravidel himself then turns up and kills the Elder Druid.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck is destroyed and Leshrac flees; Taysir confronts Ravidel and is saved by Teferi.
timeline.quote: The weakened Embereck is destroyed, and Leshrac is forced to flee.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel is horrified that Taysir disapproves of his war and sees it as betrayal.
timeline.quote: Initially ecstatic to see his mentor again, Ravidel is horrified when Taysir tells him he does not approve of the war orchestrated in his name.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's Force of Nature trap and the Chime's chaos make the earth collapse and swallow Ravidel.
timeline.quote: The earth around Ravidel collapses, and he falls.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel visits Urborg and fails to convince Lord Windgrace, an isolationist, to join him; he takes a chunk of obsidian.
timeline.quote: Ravidel leaves, not able to convince the panther warrior .

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Journeying Angel , by Art Holcomb". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eskil takes Embereck to New Argive, where Embereck tells of recovering the Golgothian Sylex and showing mercy to Ravidel.
timeline.quote: This convinced the more powerful planeswalker to hand over the Sylex to the Battle Mage.

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eskil reveals Ravidel created the Mox Beacon, and Embereck agrees to fight him.
timeline.quote: Embereck agrees to fight

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Dragon's Dance , by David Quinn , Kenny Martinez and Anibal Rodriguez". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel enrages Sandruu with out-of-context images of Jared and Kristina, sending him to find Jared.
timeline.quote: This is enough to send Sandruu into a rage

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Wishes, Lies & Dreams , by D. G. Chichester and Mark Buckingham". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel is apprenticed to the planeswalker Faralyn to escape the calamities threatening his people.
timeline.quote: his parents thought it best to apprentice the young magician to the planeswalker Faralyn

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Szat and Leshrac manipulate the planeswalkers into fighting; Rhuell and Ravidel are killed.
timeline.quote: and so was Ravidel

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Faralyn uses Ravidel's life energy to escape the Shard, leaving his corpse behind.
timeline.quote: Faralyn used his spellsquire's life energy to escape from the Shard

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kristina resurrects Ravidel with a fully manifested spark; betrayed and grieving, he goes insane and curses her with his enmity.
timeline.quote: Kristina of the Woods cast a spell of resurrection and revived Ravidel with a fully manifested spark

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir takes Ravidel on as a spellsquire.
timeline.quote: took him on as a spellsquire

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Under the wings of Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel and Taysir trap Leshrac in Phyrexia, but Szat stays out of reach.
timeline.quote: They found Leshrac and trapped him in Phyrexia

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Under the wings of Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck defeats Ravidel in a duel over the Sylex but lets him leave with it.
timeline.quote: Embereck defeated Ravidel but allowed him to leave with the Sylex

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel attacks the Summit of Minorad and uses the Sylex to blackmail several planeswalkers into servitude.
timeline.quote: Ravidel attacked this Summit of Minorad and hatched an insidious plan

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The summit of Minorad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Only Embereck refuses Ravidel's demand and vanishes with a vow of vengeance.
timeline.quote: Only Embereck refused and vanished with a vow of vengeance against Ravidel.

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The summit of Minorad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel tells Taysir that Kristina has taken a lover, provoking Taysir to attack Sandruu.
timeline.quote: Ravidel gleefully brought him the news that Kristina had taken a lover

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Manipulating Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel corrupts Lord Adam Carthalion and kills him at the Battle of Aster Fall.
timeline.quote: He corrupted Lord Adam Carthalion and eventually killed him at the Battle of Aster Fall

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Gathering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel assaults Arathoxia, destroying it and killing the Scarlet Vizier; Jared escapes.
timeline.quote: Ravidel launched an all-out assault on the city

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Gathering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana and Altair die at Ravidel's hands, and he secures the Moxes.
timeline.quote: died at Ravidel's hands

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Gathering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel plans to activate a Mox Beacon to draw his enemies to Dominaria, and succeeds in drawing Szat to Corondor, starting the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: Ravidel was destined to succeed in drawing Szat to Corondor

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The planeswalker war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared, taught by Kristina and her lover, leads the fight against Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Jared was taught by Kristina and became her lover

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The planeswalker war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared and allies travel to the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor to make a stand against Ravidel.
timeline.quote: where Jared and his companions would make their stand against Ravidel

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared uses the Rust Daggers to cast Shatter on the Golgothian Sylex, destroying it.
timeline.quote: destroying it and preventing the annihilation of Corondor

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Caliphear is unsummoned by Ravidel; Ravidel reveals his master is Taysir of Rabiah.
timeline.quote: his master was none other than Taysir of Rabiah

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hoont is slain by Ravidel's Lord of the Pit; Altair sacrifices himself to destroy the demon.
timeline.quote: Altair of Coloni sacrificed himself to destroy the demon

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel seizes the three Moxen and activates the Mox Beacon, drawing planeswalkers to Corondor.
timeline.quote: Ravidel seized the three Moxen that Kristina had carried

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared destroys the pillar under Ravidel, who plummets into the chasm.
timeline.quote: Ravidel plummeted into the chasm

citation.text: "Activation of the Mox Beacon", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel persuades Adam to sacrifice his wife Gwendolyn Mor in exchange for power.
timeline.quote: Ravidel even persuaded him to sacrifice his wife Gwendolyn Mor in exchange for power.

citation.text: "Adam Carthalion", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adam sacrifices himself with Backdraft against Ravidel, who is only wounded.
timeline.quote: Though Adam sacrificed himself to fulfill the spell, Ravidel was only wounded.

citation.text: "Adam Carthalion", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared Carthalion summons two basilisks to fight at Castle Melmereth; both die, one by Ravidel's hand.
timeline.quote: both were killed, one by Ravidel himself

citation.text: "Basilisk", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adam travels west with his army while Ravidel invades the Plains of Ephren a second time.
timeline.quote: Ravidel invaded the Plains of Ephren on his Planar Barge for the second time.

citation.text: "Battle of Aster Fall", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel mortally wounds Adam with Syphon Soul; Adam entrusts his infant son to Ezer.
timeline.quote: he entrusted his infant son, Jared Carthalion , marked with the sigil of the new moon, to his loyal spellsquire, Ezer

citation.text: "Battle of Aster Fall", section "Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adam casts Backdraft, damaging Ravidel's barge and obliterating himself.
timeline.quote: Adam’s final act of defiance was a powerful Backdraft spell

citation.text: "Battle of Aster Fall", section "Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared Carthalion stole the black lotus from House Scarlet, then used it to summon a Shivan Dragon to kill Ravidel at Castle Melmereth.
timeline.quote: Jared Carthalion stole it after the Mistress of House Scarlet let him in and showed it to him

citation.text: "Black Lotus", section "Lore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An alliance unites to defend Casindral against Ravidel's encroaching influence.
timeline.quote: the alliance that united to defend Casindral against the encroaching threat of Ravidel 's influence

citation.text: "Casindral", section "Major locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel used a surviving mechanical bird to defend Castle Melmereth; both were destroyed by a Cockatrice.
timeline.quote: both were killed and destroyed by a Cockatrice

citation.text: "Clockwork creature", section "Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel attacks Arathoxia after the Grand Sultan refuses to submit, aiming to annihilate his enemies including Jared.
timeline.quote: When the city's leader, the Grand Sultan of Arathoxia , refused to submit to the planeswalker 's demands, Ravidel chose to annihilate the city

citation.text: "Fall of Arathoxia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The four non-red houses resist but fall in rapid succession as Ravidel's juggernauts and demons overrun them.
timeline.quote: His juggernauts smashed the city gates, and his demonic hordes overran their defenses.

citation.text: "Fall of Arathoxia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lady Verdenth dies and her emerald tower is destroyed; Ravidel executes the Scarlet Vizier for perceived betrayal.
timeline.quote: The Scarlet Vizier , caught between loyalties, was executed by Ravidel for his perceived betrayal

timeline.summary: Liana of Minorad intervenes in Jared's near-duel with Ravidel and cages him while Ravidel destroys the sultan's palace.
